issues.where: the flat, out-of-focus red water in the upper left of the near foreground (x 0 to 33%, y 67 to 100%)
issues.what: the smooth red area takes on a faint blocky, mottled texture after compression that is not in the source; it only shows on a close look
issues.fix: give more bits to flat, defocused areas (lower the quantiser or raise adaptive quantisation strength) or add a little grain before encoding

issues.where: the thin ripple rings on the water at the shoreline below the far reeds (x 0 to 33%, y 0 to 33%)
issues.what: the fine concentric ripple lines soften and partly smear into the water tone, although they still read as ripples
issues.fix: raise the bitrate a little, or use a slower preset, so low-contrast moving edges on the water survive

issues.where: the faint crack-like ripple lines in the mid water right of the dome (x 67 to 100%, y 33 to 67%)
issues.what: the thin dark streaks lose definition and turn slightly smeary
issues.fix: same as above: a bit more bitrate or psycho-visual tuning to keep low-contrast detail
